economics: Official fee = 10000 per second with abs(inventory)>100, independent of excess size. Hard potential limit=1000. No simulator/rule changes.
controller: Guarded extra exposure requires same-direction inventory >=80 and forecast-after-skew >=edge. On breach cancel risk-increasing orders; after hold time cancel normal quotes and IOC excess back toward 100, reserving all pending/canceling orders. IOC price allows two ticks through the last visible market touch. One-second cooldown. No guarantee of instant exit: callbacks, latency and liquidity can delay it.
selection: Freeze nine candidates, plus baseline and disabled-controller control. Screen from tape start through prefix; exact 300-second blocks ending at 5990 seconds before EOF drain. Disabled control must match baseline. Require >=1% net-after-penalty improvement, positive gain in both halves, >=12/20 positive blocks and positive simultaneous one-sided 95% max-T bootstrap lower bound across all nine trials, 20000 circular paired draws of two blocks within each half, seed 2026110703. Hard exposure must stay <=1000 with no new-order rejections. Select greatest lower bound, cap as tie-breaker; freeze before later data. No retuning.
confirmation: Require positive after-fee gains in both later 5990-9000 and 9000-end segments and >=1% full gain. Net PnL on sample_v2 and 20/50ms stress must each be >=99% of the corresponding penalty-free baseline. Otherwise keep baseline. If no candidate passes screening, run only the best-lower-bound guarded candidate as a diagnostic; it cannot be promoted afterwards.
baseline_reuse: Verified baseline full/sample/20/50ms results from logs/robust_augmentation are reused only after matching baseline source, data and engine hashes, and exact prefix parity.
limitation: All tapes were previously examined; tests do not create a fresh holdout.
